title: The birth of pop music
sub: From work songs and ragtime to Rocket 88: the roots of everything that came after (up to 1955).

title: Youth cultures 1950-1980
sub: Rockers, mods, indorockers, hippies, punks and skinheads, and the music that went with their clothes.

title: The Beatles
sub: From a skiffle group in Liverpool to the band that invented the pop studio (1957-1970).

title: When rock was still pop
sub: From psychedelia to Mumford & Sons: how rock dominated pop music for forty years, and why that came to an end (1965-2010).

title: Jazz Festival
sub: From bebop to trip hop: how jazz turned from dance music into art music after 1945, and then turned up everywhere in pop.

title: Fear of a Black Planet
sub: Black music from 1945 onwards: soul, funk, reggae, disco, hip hop and R&B, and the struggle that resounds through it.

title: The 1980s
sub: Synthesizers, MTV, megastars and the Cold War: the decade that shaped the pop music of today.

title: Electronic music
sub: From Stockhausen and Kraftwerk via Detroit techno and Chicago house to EDM: how the machine became an instrument.

title: The instrument
sub: Electric guitar, Hammond, Mellotron, Moog, TR-808 and sampler: every new machine brought a new music with it.

title: Women in pop music
sub: From Bessie Smith and Sister Rosetta Tharpe to Björk and Billie Eilish: singer, guitarist, songwriter and producer.

title: Nederpop
sub: From indorock and Nederbeat via Golden Earring, Normaal and Doe Maar to Nederhop and today's Dutch-language hits.

title: The hit factory
sub: From Tin Pan Alley via Motown and ABBA to Max Martin: who makes a hit, and with which tools?

title: From cassette to cloud
sub: From the last real guitar battle to the playlist: how the physical format disappeared and music came to be everywhere.
